h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Aizawl

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Aizawl

items.pText: Aizawl is built along steep ridges, and flat open ground is scarce. A playground here usually has to fit a terrace, a school courtyard or a narrow strip beside a church or community hall. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for these sites at our factory in Vasai, about 2,100 km away, and sends it by road to Mizoram for installation.

On a hill site the first questions are about slope and access, before the equipment is chosen. Tell us how much the ground falls across the plot, how wide the approach road is and whether the last stretch has steps. With that, we can suggest compact pieces such as spring riders, small slides and climbers that fit tight spaces, or a multi play system if you have a levelled terrace. Mizoram has a long, wet monsoon, so we will also ask where rainwater runs off the plot. Galvanised posts and roto-moulded parts handle the damp well.

richText.heading: Fitting play equipment on Aizawl's slopes

c: Play equipment needs level ground, so a sloping plot is usually cut into one or two flat terraces with a retaining edge. Each terrace can hold a different age group, which also keeps toddlers away from older children. Leave the full safe play area flat around every piece, and never let a slide end towards a drop.

items.q: Can playground equipment be installed on sloping ground?
items.a: The ground under each piece and its safe play area must be level. On a slope we suggest cutting one or more flat terraces first. We mark these on the layout drawing so the civil work can be planned.

items.q: Which equipment suits a small hill-town site?
items.a: Spring riders, small slides, see-saws and compact climbers need little space. If you have one good level terrace, a small multi play system fits several activities into one footprint.

items.q: Do you send playground equipment to Mizoram?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture in Vasai and send the order to Aizawl by road. Tell us about the access road and any steps near the site so we can plan the dispatch.
